producer_proof_review.judgment: Seven canonical Mathlib imports, open/options and one namespace. No scoped variables adding hidden assumptions; autoImplicit=false. No other public ASTIS theorem is called.
Exact phase2 producer signature unchanged. All meaning-carrying source definitions remain literal local lets.
alpha,beta,eigenvalue,Lambda,g,t,s,w,B,K reproduce the statement; R is the actual linear-map range of B.mulVecLin, not a convenient replacement span assumed to equal it.

kappa>=2 yields beta!=0. hq gives d>0, so sqrt(d) and its inverse are nonzero. w is1 or sqrt(2), both nonzero. z=C beta^{-1}(X-C alpha) has degree1. These facts are dependency results proved inside the theorem.

U_n=X^n and Q_n=T_n comp z have degree n including n=0. degree_comp needs positive degree z, supplied by degree1; Chebyshev degree_T requires a domain and nonzero2, both true over R. Sequence.ne_zero implies nonzero leading coefficients, which are units over R. Sequence.span_degreeLT then gives both spans = polynomials of degree<q+1.

F_a(p)_i=p(lambda_i)g_a(i) is real-linear by ordinary polynomial evaluation. hpower identifies F_a(U_n) with diagonal matrix powers applied to g_a, including n=0. hangle evaluates z at actual affine eigenvalues. hcos uses the canonical real Chebyshev cosine identity. No circular range assumption is used.
hcol gives B_col(a,k)=(s*w_k)F_a(Q_k). Its k=0 branch accounts for T_0=cos0=1 and avoids an erroneous sqrt(2) in the constant feature; positive k uses the literal sqrt(2) cosine feature.
Using U's span equality, every degree<q+1 polynomial evaluates into K because its monomial generators map to actual listed Krylov vectors.
